Independently generated Bell numbers through B_803: the integer D_n is strictly negative at every n=4..235 and positive at every n=236..799. Verified 5B_801<801 B_800. The infinite tail uses a separate analytic argument: the Touchard recurrence preserves real negative zeros, hence K_n is a Poisson-binomial sum and its third cumulant has absolute value at most its variance; normalized Bell log-concavity bounds 5(B_{n+1}/B_n)<n+1 for n>=800, making the exact covariance identity strictly positive. Neither finite enumeration nor an observed sign switch alone would imply the tail.
